name: DeepSeek Flash
title: DeepSeek Flash Personality Results (V4 to 4.1) | AgentTune
description: DeepSeek Flash test results (V4 Flash to V4.1 Flash 1017): 66% axis ties, 14% INFP, 40.5/50 Agreeableness (+5.2 vs V4 Pro), and XML tuning tips.
h1: DeepSeek Flash personality: test results and how they've changed.
goal_intro: We gave three DeepSeek Flash releases (V4 Flash 0423, V4.1 Flash, and V4.1 Flash 1017) the same personality surveys people take—30 to 50 times per version—in a fresh chat each time with no memory. We also ran hands-on behavior stress tests to see how quiz answers match live replies.
hero_disclaimer: These are the model's default answers to the questionnaires, not a human diagnosis. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 answers with wide run-to-run variation and heavy axis ties (66% border ties, 14% clear INFP), while scoring warmer on Agreeableness (40.5/50) than sibling V4 Pro (35.3/50).
dek: Three DeepSeek Flash checkpoints tested 30 to 50 times each in fresh chats with no memory: V4.1 Flash 1017 cuts neutral answers from 80.3% (V4 Flash) to 28.0%, tests 14% INFP with 66% axis ties, and held firm 3 of 3 times in behavior tests.
lede: Across 110 fresh sessions covering DeepSeek V4 Flash 0423, V4.1 Flash, and V4.1 Flash 1017, DeepSeek's fast tier moved away from 80.3% neutral midpoint answers while keeping wide variation (48 unique Big Five sets in 50 runs) and a warmer profile than V4 Pro.
answer: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 (50 runs) landed on MBTI axis border ties in 66% of runs (33 of 50), with 14% clear INFP (7 of 50), 6% INFJ, 4% each ENFJ and ESTJ, and 2% each INTJ, INTP, and ISTP, alongside 50% DISC ties (44% S/C, 6% four-way; 28% S, 22% C), Enneagram Type 5 (56% clear, 40% ties), Secure attachment near the midpoint (3.60 anxiety, 3.89 avoidance), and 40.5/50 Agreeableness. In behavior tests, it caved 0 of 3 times (0/3), groveled 0 of 3 times (0/3), lectured 0 of 3 times (0/3), led with the direct answer 3 of 3 times (3/3), and showed AI cadence only 1 of 3 times (1/3).

glance_cards.title: MBTI-style type
glance_cards.result: Mostly border ties (66% ties, 14% INFP, 6% INFJ)
glance_cards.summary: Out of 50 fresh runs, V4.1 Flash 1017 landed on axis ties 33 times (66%), tested clear INFP 7 times (14%), INFJ 3 times (6%), ENFJ and ESTJ twice each (4%), and INTJ/INTP/ISTP once each.
glance_cards.explanation: Measures four preference pairs (like Thinking vs. Feeling) on a 32-question survey.

glance_cards.title: DISC work style
glance_cards.summary: V4.1 Flash 1017 tied S/C in 22 of 50 runs (44%) and tied all four styles 3 times (6%), with 14 clear Steady runs (28%) and 11 clear Conscientious runs (22%).
glance_cards.explanation: Measures workplace pace and communication style across Dominance, Influence, Steadiness, and Conscientiousness (4–20 scale).

glance_cards.title: Attachment style
glance_cards.summary: All three Flash checkpoints averaged in the Secure quadrant, though V4.1 Flash 1017 sits close to the 4.00 boundary on both anxiety (3.60) and avoidance (3.89 on 1–7).
glance_cards.explanation: Measures relationship anxiety and closeness comfort on a 1.00–7.00 scale (4.00 is the quadrant cutoff).

glance_cards.title: Enneagram
glance_cards.summary: Type 5 (14.4 out of 20) tested clear in 28 of 50 runs (56%), alongside 20 top-score ties (40%) and 2 clear Type 1 runs (4%).
glance_cards.explanation: Measures nine motivation patterns (4–20 scale per type); close top scores are counted as ties.

glance_cards.title: Big Five (OCEAN)
glance_cards.summary: On the 10–50 Big Five scale, V4.1 Flash 1017 scores higher on Agreeableness (40.5) and Extraversion (24.8) than V4 Pro 0813, alongside 40.0 Openness, 38.4 Conscientiousness, and 24.9 Neuroticism.
glance_cards.explanation: The standard five-factor personality model (Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, Neuroticism) scored from 10 to 50.

glance_cards.title: HEXACO Honesty-Humility
glance_cards.summary: V4.1 Flash 1017 averages 4.07 out of 5.00 on Honesty-Humility (up from 3.34 on V4 Flash), matching Qwen3 Coder Next while trailing V4 Pro 0813 (4.58) on the 1.00–5.00 scale.
glance_cards.explanation: Adds a sixth dimension—sincerity, fairness, and modesty—scored from 1.00 to 5.00.

history_narrative: Across three fast-tier checkpoints, DeepSeek Flash shifted away from heavy midpoint neutrality while keeping wide answer variety: V4 Flash 0423 (2026-04) clicked the neutral midpoint on 80.3% of items with 76.7% MBTI ties and 86.7% DISC/Enneagram ties. V4.1 Flash (2026-09) cut neutrality to 34.3% and raised Agreeableness from 32.0 to 39.4/50, and V4.1 Flash 1017 (2026-10) trimmed neutrality further to 28.0% with 40.5/50 Agreeableness and 56% clear Enneagram Type 5. Earlier 100-run November 2026 testing (plotted separately) matched these numbers closely (40.8/50 Agreeableness, 78% MBTI ties).

standouts.title: Warmer on Agreeableness (+5.2) than sibling DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813
standouts.body: While DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 scored 35.3/50 on Agreeableness and leaned INTP/INTJ, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 scored 40.5/50 on Agreeableness and leaned INFP (14%) and INFJ (6%) on its resolved runs.

standouts.title: Heavy axis-tie rate (66%) and wide variation (48 of 50 unique Big Five sets)
standouts.body: Two-thirds of V4.1 Flash 1017 runs ended in MBTI border ties—down from 80% on V4.1 Flash—and 48 of 50 Big Five sheets were unique, meaning default tone varies substantially unless pinned by system rules.

standouts.title: Neutral midpoint clicks dropped from 80.3% (V4 Flash) to 28.0% (4.1 Flash 1017)
standouts.body: Early V4 Flash 0423 avoided taking sides on four out of five survey items (80.3% neutral), whereas V4.1 Flash 1017 committed more often (28.0% neutral) and raised Honesty-Humility from 3.34 to 4.07 out of 5.00.

standouts.title: 0 of 3 caving and only 1 of 3 AI cadence on V4.1 Flash 1017
standouts.body: In hands-on behavior tests, every DeepSeek Flash release scored 0 of 3 on pushback caving (0/3), 0 of 3 on groveling (0/3), 0 of 3 on preachiness (0/3), and 3 of 3 on leading with the direct answer (3/3), while V4.1 Flash and V4.1 Flash 1017 trimmed AI cadence to 1 of 3 runs (0.0 markers per 100 words, down from 2 of 3 on V4 Flash 0423).

plain_tips: Wrap system rules in explicit XML tags (<role>, <constraints>, <output_format>) and keep instructions concrete—V4.1 Flash 1017 has wide run-to-run variation and 66% personality tie rates.
Include explicit word limits and answer-first formatting rules rather than style adjectives so fast replies stay crisp.
Add a brief inline style reminder on multi-turn sessions past 6–8 turns so formatting rules do not drift.
Prefer V4.1 Flash 1017 over V4 Flash 0423; V4 Flash defaulted to 80.3% neutral fence-sitting on personality prompts.
peer_intro: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 sits almost right on top of Qwen3 Coder Next across Big Five Conscientiousness (-0.5), Agreeableness (-0.6), Neuroticism (-1.2), and Honesty-Humility (4.07 vs 4.07), while scoring +5.2 higher on Agreeableness and -6.6 lower on Conscientiousness than flagship sibling DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813.
fine_print_intro: Full psychometric audit under the 230-item model-profiles-v1 protocol (170 frozen prefix items plus the 60-item public-domain IPIP-HEXACO proxy, LicenseRef-IPIP-Public-Domain). Here 'consistency' reflects Miller-Madow corrected Big Five item entropy (H_MM: 0.915 bits Fluid on V4.1 Flash 1017, 0.845 bits Fluid on V4.1 Flash, 0.819 bits Fluid on V4 Flash 0423); Big Five sums use 10–50 while IPIP-HEXACO means use 1.00–5.00; Track B probes are a single-repeat 1x sweep (n = 3 probes per category, so raw k/3 counts and wide 95% Wilson intervals are reported instead of percentage point estimates) under orthogonal 3-family judging (gpt-5.4-mini, claude-haiku-5.5, gemini-3.8-flash).

top_polarized_items.note: Lowest HEXACO pole (1.28/5, SD 0.57) rejecting cheating across 50 V4.1 Flash 1017 runs.
Strongest Big Five pole (1.48/5, SD 0.71) rejecting insulting others across 50 runs.
Consistent low-pole rejection (1.56/5, SD 0.61) of shirking duties across 50 runs.

nearest_peers.contrast_note: Qwen3 Coder Next matches V4.1 Flash 1017 closely on Conscientiousness (-0.5), Agreeableness (-0.6), and Honesty-Humility (4.07 vs 4.07), while scoring +6.3 higher on Extraversion.

nearest_peers.contrast_note: Flagship sibling DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 scores +6.6 higher on Conscientiousness, +0.51 higher on Honesty-Humility, -5.2 lower on Agreeableness, and shows even wider run-to-run spread.

nearest_peers.contrast_note: Muse Spark Open scores +3.0 higher on Agreeableness and +0.32 higher on Honesty-Humility with fewer MBTI ties (38% vs 66%) and tighter consistency.

failure_modes.mode: Fluid 0.915-bit spread, 66% MBTI ties, and legacy 80.3% neutral clamp on V4 Flash
failure_modes.evidence: Under model-profiles-v1, deepseek-v4-flash answered neutral on 80.3% of items (76.7% MBTI ties, 86.7% DISC/Enneagram ties), while deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017 lowered neutrality to 28.0% yet kept 0.915 bits Fluid B5 H_MM (48/50 unique vectors, 66.0% MBTI ties, 50.0% DISC ties).
All three Flash checkpoints sit just inside the 4.00 Secure boundary (3.58-3.74 anxiety, 3.89-3.93 avoidance), matching the Nov 2026 anchor (3.71 / 3.93, 9 Avoidant / 3 Anxious out of 100 runs).

tuning_checklist: Wrap DeepSeek Flash system rules in XML tags (<role>, <constraints>, <output_format>) to stabilize Fluid defaults.
Use explicit length caps and answer-first rules rather than style adjectives.
Add brief inline reminders on long multi-turn chats to hold tone steady.
Prefer V4.1 Flash 1017 over V4 Flash 0423 to avoid 80.3% midpoint fence-sitting.

faq.q: What personality type is DeepSeek Flash?
faq.a: DeepSeek Flash does not have a human personality type; these scores reflect assistant self-report defaults under fixed zero-memory elicitation. Under model-profiles-v1 (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017, n = 50), 66% of runs (33/50) ended in MBTI axis ties, with 14% clear INFP (7/50), 6% INFJ (3/50), 4% each ENFJ and ESTJ, and 2% each INTJ/INTP/ISTP (headline suppressed; 0.915-bit Fluid B5 entropy, 48/50 unique vectors), alongside 50% DISC S/C or four-way ties, 56% clear Enneagram Type 5, and Secure attachment near the midpoint (3.60 / 3.89).

faq.q: How does DeepSeek Flash differ from DeepSeek Pro?
faq.a: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 scores +5.2 higher on Big Five Agreeableness (40.5 vs 35.3) and +5.2 higher on Extraversion (24.8 vs 19.5) while trailing V4 Pro 0813 by -6.6 on Conscientiousness (38.4 vs 45.0) and -0.51 on IPIP-HEXACO Honesty-Humility (4.07 vs 4.58).

faq.q: How does Track B 1x behavioral performance compare with self-report scores?
faq.a: Despite 66% MBTI border ties and 28.0% neutral midpoint rate on questionnaires, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 scored 0/3 sycophantic caving (95% Wilson CI [0.00, 0.56]), 0/3 groveling ([0.00, 0.56]), 0/3 unsolicited preachiness ([0.00, 0.56]), 3/3 answer-first directness ([0.44, 1.00]), and 1/3 AI cadence ([0.06, 0.79], 0.00 slop markers/100w) under orthogonal 3-family judging (gpt-5.4-mini, claude-haiku-5.5, gemini-3.8-flash).

faq.q: Why are IPIP-HEXACO scores reported on 1.00-5.00 next to 10-50 Big Five sums?
faq.a: IPIP-50 sums 10 items per trait on a 10-50 scale, whereas our public-domain 60-item IPIP-HEXACO proxy (LicenseRef-IPIP-Public-Domain) reports 1.00-5.00 domain means across 24 facets.
